t: This is Suffolk Street, a street in the City of Westminster. It's a quiet stretch, and the thing worth knowing is who once lived here. John Laws Milton, a nineteenth-century British dermatologist and medical writer, made his home on this street. He lived from 1820 to 1898, and he wrote about skin diseases for the medical profession of his day. Beyond that, I don't have much more to tell you about the street itself, so take a moment to look at the buildings around you and imagine the Victorian doctor coming and going.
